anatomie.description: Projection corps entier au FDG : la fixation physiologique reste dans la colonne du corps, entre les repères R et L.
Hyperfixation cérébrale intense, en haut de la projection.
Fixation cardiaque, tache médiothoracique à gauche du mot HEART, entre le cerveau et la vessie.

patho.author: Bert-Ram Sah; Alexey Eyrikh; Lars Husmann; Aresh Farokhnia; Urs J Muehlematter; Stephan Beintner-Skawran; Fotis Kotasidis; Munenobu Nogami; Junko Inoue Inukai; Alexander Maurer; Martin W Huellner
patho.caption_source: Patient with large-vessel vasculitis and polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR). A and B, Standard static SUV image dataset (TOF-BSREM), acquired 60 min postinjection. C and D, MR FDG image dataset of multipass multibed dynamic acquisition. Both reconstructions show increased FDG uptake in the large joints as sign of active PMR. In addition, MR FDG images revealed increased FDG uptake in the aortic wall, represented by higher TBR of the aortic wall compared with static PET images, in line with the clinical diagnosis of large-vessel vasculitis.
patho.note: Visage et pelvis masqués par des pastilles noires, sans identifiant lisible. Flèches sources : épaule et hanche sur les MIP, paroi aortique sur l'axial D.
